name: Silent Stay
detailed_description:
Silent Stay

Dive into the unsettling world of Silent Stay, a narrative horror game with psychological elements.

You step into the role of Alex Miller, a writer who has rented a remote cabin in the woods to finally finish his book. The cabin seems perfect: far from the city, no neighbors, just you and your thoughts. But after just a few days, strange events begin to accumulate that make you question your sanity.

Experience Alex's Story
You experience the events in the cabin live from Alex's perspective as the strange and increasingly disturbing incidents unfold before your eyes. The story is rich with subtle clues and shocking twists, complemented by mysterious notes, eerie sounds, and other details that Alex discovers in real-time.

Atmospheric Horror

  • Psychological Tension: A growing sense of unease created by inexplicable events and a dark, oppressive atmosphere.

  • Mix of Subtle and Intense: Horror elements range from creeping discomfort to sudden shocks, maintaining constant tension.

Your Writing Time Becomes a Nightmare

  • Interactive Gameplay: Write, explore the cabin and more – until nothing seems normal anymore.

  • Carefully Crafted Horror: Every event is precisely designed to draw you deeper into the dark narrative.

  • No Enemies, Only Fear: There's no classic monster chasing you. The threat is subtle, psychological, and omnipresent.

short_description: Alex Miller, a writer seeking inspiration, rented a remote cabin in the woods. It was supposed to be the perfect retreat: peace, nature, no distractions. But soon he notices strange things - objects move, mysterious notes appear. Someone seems to be sharing his presence without him knowing it.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 | AMD FX-6350
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB | AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB

content_descriptors.notes: Silent Stay contains themes of death as well as depictions of violence, blood, and intense fear. Player discretion is advised.
